fit_sentence: SAP Architecture Reference page for Joule in S/4HANA Cloud (Public & Private Edition) lists the standard capability modes, activation prerequisites, OData backend, supported scenarios and architecture, defining the capability boundary used in T5 practical recommendations.
deliverable_artifact: Architecture + capability matrix (Conversational AI, Transactional Execution, Navigational patterns, Help enablement) and UI5/Release prerequisites table.
resource_type_reason: SAP official architecture.learning.sap.com reference page; canonical, not a community post or extension how-to.
why_recommended: SAP 官方参考架构：明确 Joule 在 S/4HANA Cloud 公私两版的标准能力（对话、事务执行、导航、帮助）与后端 OData、UI5、Release 前置条件，可作为能力边界锚点。

material_claims.claim: Transactional execution support (e.g., PO creation) depends on active OData backend services
